title: Full-Stack Development
tagline: Ship a production-grade product from schema to deployment.
description: Master the MERN stack by building real products — authentication, realtime features, payments, and cloud deployment — graded like a senior engineer would grade you.

title: Foundational Web Development
tagline: Master the raw ingredients before the frameworks.
description: A fast, rigorous bootcamp in the core web languages. Build a dozen pixel-perfect, accessible interfaces with zero frameworks.

title: Front-End Development
tagline: Design systems, motion, and component engineering.
description: Deep-dive into the modern front-end. You will ship design-systems-grade components with animation, testing, and accessibility baked in.

title: Back-End Engineering
tagline: Scale APIs the way production systems are built.
description: Design, build, and stress-test APIs and data pipelines. Learn indexing, caching, and concurrency with real production patterns.

title: Mobile App Development
tagline: Native-feel apps, shipped to real stores.
description: Build cross-platform and native mobile apps with buttery animations, offline-first data, and a release-ready store pipeline.

title: Data Science
description: The full analytics workflow — acquisition, cleaning, exploration, modeling, and vivid visual storytelling on real-world datasets.

title: Artificial Intelligence & LLM Dev
tagline: Build agents, RAG systems, and prompt engineering.
description: From prompt engineering to retrieval-augmented generation and autonomous agents — build LLM applications that actually ship.

title: Machine Learning Engineering
tagline: From Jupyter notebook to deployed model.
description: Train, evaluate, and serve machine learning models — covering classical ML and deep learning with an MLOps-first mindset.

title: Data Engineering & ETL Pipelines
tagline: Move data at scale, reliably, automatically.
description: Design robust ETL/ELT pipelines — orchestration, streaming, storage, and analytics-friendly warehouse modeling.

title: Business Intelligence & Analytics
description: Learn to transform raw operations into interactive dashboards, KPI systems, and forecasts that drive real decisions.

title: Cybersecurity
tagline: Break systems legally. Defend them seriously.
description: Hands-on penetration testing and security operations in sandboxed labs — reconnaissance, exploitation, and defense playbooks.

title: DevOps Engineering
description: Own the full delivery loop — containerization, orchestration, infrastructure-as-code, and observability.

title: Network Engineering
tagline: Design the fabric underneath every app.
description: Build and debug real network topologies — switching, routing protocols, segmentation, and packet-level analysis.

title: UI/UX Design
tagline: Interfaces people fall in love with.
description: The complete designer track — research, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, design systems, and prototype motion.
